verdict.rationale: Viam has a dedicated guide for AI agents: an agent with a shell or SDK can operate a machine the same way a person or program can, listing resources and status and planning collision-checked motion via the motion service. The CLI calls any machine API method with JSON in and out, and the machine API sends commands remotely. Scoping is documented through per-resource, per-method `user_permissions`, and the fleet API manages permissions and authorization. Missing for 10: explicit docs on issuing and scoping the agent's own credentials (e.g., API key creation and roles), and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent driving a real robot end-to-end.
